dsh-auth-gate 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

posts.en:
dsh-auth-gate is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-29f16fd3e3a522f886b3.html
